summary: Backend-only regression targeting the 'Pubblicazione non riuscita' bug on POST /api/observations. Result: 11/11 tests PASS (100%). The publish flow is fully healthy end-to-end. Verified: (1) POST /api/auth/login with explorer@overview.app / overview123 returns a bearer access_token; (2) POST /api/observations with the exact frontend payload {media_type:'image', source:'reality', description, hashtags, image_base64:<tiny valid JPEG>, data:{lat,lon,planets:[],stars:[],places:[{Roma...}]}} returns 200 with a valid 'id', persists media (image_url=/api/media/{id}), preserves lat/lon/hashtags and data.places verbatim; (3) PERSISTENCE — GET /api/observations/{id} returns the same doc WITH data.places[0].name=='Roma' AND the created Observe appears in GET /api/feed?sort=recent&limit=100; (4) 3 back-to-back publishes all return 200 with 3 distinct ids — no intermittent 500s; (5) AUTH ENFORCEMENT — POST /api/observations WITHOUT Authorization → 401 (not 500), with a bogus Bearer → 401; (6) VALIDATION — invalid hashtags type → 422, invalid base64 image → 400 ('Immagine non valida'), empty body → 200 (all CreateObs fields optional by design), never 500. Backend logs stayed clean during the run. The generic Italian error 'Pubblicazione non riuscita' shown to users was a CLIENT-SIDE catch-all; the backend endpoint is stable and returns explicit, appropriate 4xx codes on bad input — main agent's client-side improvement is warranted.
action_items: None on the backend — publish endpoint is healthy and returns clear 4xx codes on bad input. The 'Pubblicazione non riuscita' toast comes from the frontend catch-all; keep the client-side error surfacing that pulls FastAPI's `detail` field on 4xx (as main agent already improved in /app/frontend/src/lib/publishError.ts) so users see the specific reason (e.g. 'Immagine non valida' → 400, moderation → 422, auth → 401).
critical_code_review_comments: social.py:362-437 create_observation is idempotent per request, validates image_base64 with a try/except (→ 400 'Immagine non valida'), routes user photos through moderate_image_safe which fails OPEN on LLM errors — legitimate publishes cannot be blocked by an AI outage. Good.

social.py:345-359 CreateObs pydantic model: all fields optional with sensible defaults (media_type='image', source='reality') — empty body {} returns 200. This is intentional but worth noting: it means the API tolerates an 'empty' Observe, so the frontend must guarantee at least an image or caption before POSTing. Not a bug, just a contract note.
auth.py:238-... get_current_user with HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) correctly raises 401 (not 403) for missing/invalid tokens on protected routes — matches the request spec.

social.py:388 derive_categories + compute_scientific_value work with the exact 'places' payload (they ignore unknown keys), so adding new place metadata client-side is safe and does not break the create path.

rca_of_issue: Reported bug 'Pubblicazione non riuscita' was NOT reproducible against the current backend — POST /api/observations returns 200 for the exact payload the user sends. The generic Italian error was a frontend catch-all in publish-composer.tsx that surfaced ANY thrown error (network, moderation, validation, auth) with the same string. Backend already returns explicit `detail` messages ('Immagine non valida' 400, moderation 422, auth 401, pydantic 422). Recommended mitigation (already applied by main agent in publishError.ts / client.ts): parse the FastAPI `detail` field on non-2xx and show it to the user instead of the generic label.
